name: Komering terrain (GLO-30, Terrarium)
attribution: Elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the EU and ESA. Satellite surface model, not a survey. River bed below the water surface assumed (not a survey). River bed below the water surface assumed (not a survey).
description: Copernicus GLO-30 surface model resampled bilinear to web mercator. Zoom 6-12 over the wide box, zoom 13 and 14 inside the fine box only (manifest gives the tile ranges; MapLibre overzooms elsewhere). Heights m above EGM2008, quantised to 0.25 m; voids, sea and anything outside 103-105 E, 6-3 S are 0 m. CARVED RIVER BED (lane g07, 23 Nov 2026): the surface model records Sungai Komering at its water surface, so from 5 km above to 5 km below Bendung Perjaya (along the river, 500 m ramps at the ends) the terrain inside the 26 Apr 2026 Sentinel-2 river outline is lowered to an ASSUMED bed: 70.8 m above the axis (design bed EL 74.0) and 70.95 m below it (EL 74.15, Manning bed for the design flood), or the surface model's water surface minus the axis depth where that is lower, banks 1:2 from the outline's edge, and 68.8 m (1 m below the assumed stilling basin floor EL 73.0) under the weir model's footprint + 10 m. Levels from params.json (terrain m = project EL - 3.2). The bed is assumed, not surveyed. Tile URLs are relative to this file.
